name: Cowardice Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Despair

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the feed on hopes power of the despair domain.

Aura of Despair (Su)

At 8th level, you can emit a 30-foot aura of hopelessness for a number of rounds per day equal to your cleric level. Using this ability is a swift action. Enemies in the area must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the cleric’s level + the cleric’s Wis modifier) or be despairing while in the radius of the aura and for 1d4 rounds thereafter. The rounds the aura is active do not need to be consecutive. Any creature that succeeds on their saving throw or has already been affected by the aura is immune to its effects for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting, emotion and despair effect.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st-lesser cowardice, 3rd-cowardice, 6th-greater cowardice
